implementationPlan.title: Let Them + Let Me Practice
implementationPlan.coreSkill: The skill is to notice the moment when attention leaves the reader's own choices and starts managing another person. In this source, Let Them + Let Me brings attention back to conduct, boundaries, requests, repair, or acceptance. The reader practices by naming the uncontrollable part and then choosing one honest action.

ifThenPlans.plan: If a situation resembles Girls' weekend social-media spiral, then pause before fixing the outcome and write the response that still belongs to you.
If a conversation starts to repeat Chris on the couch, then speak one clear sentence and stop trying to force agreement.
